rows.definition_verbatim:
Rule, instantiated with the rates row (O 07:20, C 14:00; the clock comes from the frozen tables):
- Daily bar of trade date d, from its bars on CT date d opening in [O, C) = [07:20, 14:00):
  H / L = max high / min low over the present bars, C_d = close of the bar at C-1 = 13:59.
  (O_d, the 07:20 open, enters no condition of H6 and is not read; the 07:20 bar must exist.)
- Complete day (Family H): the 07:20 and 13:59 bars exist, no bar of CT date d carries
  early_halt_ct, and all bars in [07:20, 14:00) carry one instrument_id. It is finalised when a
  bar of a later trade date arrives, so day d's own bar never enters day d's condition.
- d-1 = the most recent COMPLETE daily bar of an earlier trade date; incomplete days are dropped
  (L-09). None yet (warm-up, the window's start): no trade.
- On the bar at O = 07:20 of CT date d (that exact bar, S0.6): no trade if it carries
  early_halt_ct (L-09, L-11); instrument guard (H6 GUARDED_BARS = 1): d-1's instrument_id must be
  the 07:20 bar's; Range = H - L of d-1 in ticks must be > 0; CLV = (C - L) / (H - L) in ticks,
  CLV >= 0.8 buys, CLV <= 0.2 sells (non-strict), else no trade. The cuts are compared exactly in
  integers (L-19). Market intent on the 07:20 bar (fills at the 07:21 open).
- Exit: market intent on the first present bar at or after C-2 = 13:58 (fills nominally at the
  13:59 open), resent while refused (S0.7, L-10, L-22). The engine's forced flatten at F is the
  backstop.

rows.side_rule: CLV >= 0.8 buys, CLV <= 0.2 sells (non-strict), else no trade
rows.side_kind: other: side from d-1's close location in its 07:20-14:00 range (buy when d-1 closed in its top 20%, sell in its bottom 20%); not a signed price move of the trigger day
rows.intraday_hold: true: 07:21 open to 13:59 open (E.3 mean hold 376.5-397.5 min); flat by F (15:08 CT on a regular rates day)

Rule, instantiated with the rates row (O 07:20, C 14:00; the clock comes from the frozen tables):
- Daily bar of trade date d, from its bars on CT date d opening in [O, C) = [07:20, 14:00):
  H / L = max high / min low over the present bars, C_d = close of the bar at C-1 = 13:59.
  (O_d, the 07:20 open, enters no condition of H6 and is not read; the 07:20 bar must exist.)
- Complete day (Family H): the 07:20 and 13:59 bars exist, no bar of CT date d carries
  early_halt_ct, and all bars in [07:20, 14:00) carry one instrument_id. It is finalised when a
  bar of a later trade date arrives, so day d's own bar never enters day d's condition.
- d-1 = the most recent COMPLETE daily bar of an earlier trade date; incomplete days are dropped
  (L-09). None yet (warm-up, the window's start): no trade.
- On the bar at O = 07:20 of CT date d (that exact bar, S0.6): no trade if it carries
  early_halt_ct (L-09, L-11); instrument guard (H6 GUARDED_BARS = 1): d-1's instrument_id must be
  the 07:20 bar's; Range = H - L of d-1 in ticks must be > 0; CLV = (C - L) / (H - L) in ticks,
  CLV >= 0.8 buys, CLV <= 0.2 sells (non-strict), else no trade. The cuts are compared exactly in
  integers (L-19). Market intent on the 07:20 bar (fills at the 07:21 open).

  13:59 open), resent while refused (S0.7, L-10, L-22). The engine's forced flatten at F is the
  backstop.
